articles.title: Vector Databases Full Course for Beginners – Embeddings, Similarity Search & ChromaDB
articles.summary: Learn how vector databases work, from the math behind vectors to building semantic search with ChromaDB. This beginner course covers vectors, cosine similarity, Euclidean distance, tokenization, and embedding models, then walks through a live demo of generating embeddings with Google's Gemini…
body: ❤️ Support for this channel comes from our friends at Scrimba – the coding platform that's reinvented interactive learning:
- 0:00:00 Introduction & Course Overview
points: Learn how vector databases work, from the math behind vectors to building semantic search with ChromaDB.
This beginner course covers vectors, cosine similarity, Euclidean distance, tokenization, and embedding models, then walks through a live demo of generating embeddings with Google's Gemini…
You will also explore the internal architecture of a vector database, including storage, indexing, and the IVF and HNSW index types.
By the end, you will store embeddings in ChromaDB and run semantic searches that find matches by meaning instead of by keyword.
